items.html: And in order for the dross and the shells to be revealed, it is impossible save through the cascading of the worlds, and at their completion the dross will be sorted and will come out into actuality. All this came about through the death of these kings, all of whom are mighty judgments called the name BON, which are the Gevurot; for all of these are Nekudot, which are females and reflected light, MAN [Mayin Nukvin]. And the form of the Nekudot is sparks, and they are the mighty sparks mentioned in Parashat Pekudei, p. 254. And come and see: “The head, the beginning of the faith, within thought, struck the Botzina de Kardinuta [the hard spark]” etc., “and sparks ascended.”
